_comment: 2026-09-22 demo run in the flight3 cube: long, sharp legs corner to opposite corner, alternating high far corners (z 135) and low near corners (z 70), so every leg is 1.2 m across, 0.9 m deep and 65 cm up or down, flown as straight axis moves at 50 cm/s with a settle pause between them. Up to 3 trims at 20 cm/s, then back to the takeoff point. Fly with docs/wp5-flight3-site.json and docs/wp5-flight3-map.json.
